messages.text: Keep both Council assignments and change our request to Guard, without Warrant, to match the crown's definite protection plan. The new distribution benefit improves the civilian result but reveals no viable target for combat. Even if an attack proved affordable, an unsupported Raid would still risk costing conditioning and stores together. We should take the strongest dependable outcome now and insist that our voluntary protection and accepted readiness loss count when autonomy is debated.

reason: The disclosure changes my confidence in the Repair-and-Trade arrangement, not asset commitments or my constitutional demand. Switching Restraint plus Warrant to Guard without Warrant coordinates our request with the public directives; either uses Vigil once. The benefit is evidence for accepting a noncombat month, not evidence that another Raid would succeed.
